activity_additions.name: Familiarisation (weekly triple-charm D&D)
requirements: Speak to Pikkupstix in Taverley to start (no Wolf Whistle required to play)
Find Pikkenmix at the currently active small obelisk (sparkling small obelisks teleport to Pikkupstix while active)
Collect up to 60 raw shards in the Spirit Plane before focus depletes (max ~20 minutes)
Weekly participation lock — resets Wednesday 00:00 UTC
Optional quest coverage for more obelisk sites: Fishing Contest, Heroes' Quest, Lost City, partial Lunar Diplomacy / Regicide / Eadgar's Ruse, Cabin Fever, Shilo Village, etc.
unlocks: Weekly Familiarisation access as the primary ironman charm-throughput D&D
Raw-shard score converts to a temporary triple-charm drop reward (up to 40 minutes; excludes elder charms, talon beast charms, Bork guaranteed charms, ork legion)
Active-obelisk window also grants easy large-obelisk pouch access via small-obelisk teleports to Pikkupstix
Full shaman's outfit improves chance to play as a new familiar form (A Bit TOO Familiar achievement path)
region_pressure: Asgarnia hard-owns Pikkupstix start, Taverley large-obelisk adjacency, and the default Familiarisation hub.
Active small-obelisk sites scatter across many regions — more quest-unlocked sites only improve hit rate, not the reward effect.
activity_additions.notes: Complements asgarnia:pikkupstix-summoning-obelisk (production home) without re-emitting that id. Temporary charm buff, not a permanent passive — still planner-critical weekly Summoning infrastructure. Do not invent shard-to-minute formulas beyond wiki 40-minute cap.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia for hub start. Optional multi-region obelisk geography only expands play windows.

Tirannwn optional: Wythien Prif shop is convenience only after Plague's End — not a second hard gate.
